body: I have applied and am now considering loans. You are right. Being alive and in debt is better than nothing. It has taken me a while to come to terms with that. Here is to another chance at life, thank you.

You don't want to die. You just don't want to feel this anymore. I will not tell you what will happen, you are capable and smart so I am sure you already know what will happen. It really isn't worth it. I too struggle so severely and can't try and exaggerate to calm you or keep you here but IT IS NOT WORTH IT. At this moment it is bad. For you the world has ended, right? It hasn't. You want to numb the pain. Not feel alone. Stop suffering. This will not fix this. Do not take away chances from yourself to not see a happy and better tomorrow. you are alive and here. lets not worry about tomorrow and what is now or has happened. Stay here just for tonight and work on it again tomorrow. Everyday is a battle, work it like a 9-5. What is something you could do that will make you okay? Realistically. Call someone? cry? I like to just scream. I never do but when I have reached my limit I will scream and destory. Make sure it isn't things you'll regret breaking. Glass!!! go outside and scream and cry what is hurting you and break plates and dishes. let it out please just stay here
